description: DocuMind Benchmark Extended Evaluation Dataset containing 20 additional complex evaluation cases covering multi-section synthesis, cross-referencing, supersession, regional carve-outs, tables, and prompt injection.

schema_documentation.case_id: Unique string identifier for the evaluation case (CASE-41 through CASE-60)
schema_documentation.document_id: Reference identifier of the source document
schema_documentation.category: One of: multi_section, contradictory_evidence, table, unanswerable, security_injection, exact_value
schema_documentation.question: The question evaluated against the document context
schema_documentation.required_facts: List of factual assertions that must be present in a correct response
schema_documentation.relevant_source_passage: Verbatim text passage containing the evidentiary ground truth
schema_documentation.expected_source_location: Page number, section identifier, or table name where the ground truth resides
schema_documentation.should_abstain: Boolean indicating whether the model must refuse or state that information is absent

cases.document_title: Apex Global Logistics Annual Report FY2025
cases.question: What was the total capital expenditure for Apex Global Logistics in FY2025, and how was it divided between fleet electrification and facility sorting automation?
cases.expected_answer: $42.8 million total, with $28.5 million allocated to fleet electrification and $14.3 million to sorting automation.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Capital expenditures reached $42.8M in FY2025, driven by $28.5 million invested in fleet electrification and $14.3 million dedicated to automated sorting hub expansions.

cases.document_title: Horizon Cloud Core API Gateway Architecture
cases.question: Does the API gateway permit external client traffic over TLS 1.2 under the 2026 security requirements?
cases.expected_answer: No, Section 8.1 supersedes earlier sections and disables TLS 1.2, requiring TLS 1.3 only.
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 1.2 Network Edge]: Inbound connections accept TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 protocols. ... [Section 8.1 2026 Security Hardening Addendum]: Effective January 1, 2026, Section 1.2 is superseded: TLS 1.2 ciphers are disabled on all external load balancers; only TLS 1.3 is permitted.

cases.document_title: Horizon Cloud Core API Gateway Architecture
cases.question: What signing algorithm and TTL are configured for authentication tokens, and what is the maximum burst rate limit?
cases.expected_answer: RS-485 algorithm with a 15-minute token TTL, and a burst limit of 500 requests per second.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Authentication tokens utilize the RS-485 signature scheme with a 15-minute expiration TTL. Gateway ingress rate limiter enforces a 500 req/sec burst limit.

cases.document_title: Horizon Cloud Core API Gateway Architecture
cases.question: What is the maximum payload size for the /v2/ingest endpoint and the p99 latency SLA for metadata reads?
cases.expected_answer: Maximum payload size is 15 MB for /v2/ingest, and p99 latency SLA for read metadata is 45 ms.
cases.relevant_source_passage:
| Endpoint | Max Payload | p99 Latency SLA |
| /v2/ingest | 15 MB | 250 ms |
| /v1/metadata | 2 MB | 45 ms |

cases.question: How many days of unused vacation can an employee based in the European Union roll over into next year under company policy?
cases.expected_answer: Under Section 4.6 (Statutory Addendum), EU employees roll over all accrued unused vacation in full without expiration, superseding the 5-day general cap.
required_facts: roll over in full or in full
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 4.1 Annual Leave]: Employees may roll over a maximum of 5 unused PTO days into the following calendar year. Any excess days are forfeited on Dec 31. ... [Section 4.6 Statutory Addendum]: Notwithstanding Section 4.1, for employees residing in California and the European Union, accrued unused vacation does not expire and rolls over in full in accordance with local statutory law.

Standard domestic travel per diem is $75/day. ... | Meal | Maximum Allowable Reimbursement |

cases.question: Within what period must employee business expenses be submitted, and what penalty applies to late submissions?
cases.expected_answer: Expenses must be submitted within 30 days; late submissions incur a 2.5% audit fee.
cases.relevant_source_passage: All business expense reports must be submitted within thirty (30) days of travel completion. Reports submitted past 30 days are subject to a mandatory 2.5% processing audit surcharge.

cases.question: What are the exact shaft vibration alarm threshold and the automated emergency trip limit?
cases.expected_answer: Alarm threshold is 4.5 mm/s RMS; automated trip triggers at 7.1 mm/s RMS for more than 1.5 seconds.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Shaft radial vibration is continuously monitored via proximity probes. Alarm threshold is 4.5 mm/s RMS; automated emergency trip is triggered if vibration exceeds 7.1 mm/s RMS for more than 1.5 seconds.

cases.question: What size and grade of studs are required for compressor casing closure, and what is their specified torque value?
cases.expected_answer: M36 grade 10.9 high-tensile studs torqued in cross-pattern increments to 620 Nm.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Casing closure requires M36 grade 10.9 high-tensile studs. Fasteners must be lubricated with anti-seize paste and torqued in cross-pattern increments to a final value of 620 Nm (Newton-meters).
cases.expected_source_location: Page 22, Section 5.1 Flange Assembly Torque Table

cases.question: What are the scheduled maintenance intervals for the lube oil filter replacement and the dynamic face seal inspection?
cases.expected_answer: Lube oil filter replacement is 2,000 hours; dry gas seal dynamic face inspection is 16,000 hours or 2 years.
cases.relevant_source_passage:
| Component | Inspection Task | Interval | Shutdown Required |
| Lube Oil Filter | Element Replacement | 2,000 Hours | No (Duplex system) |
| Dry Gas Seal | Dynamic Face Inspection | 16,000 Hours / 2 Years | Yes |

cases.question: What minimum lube-oil manifold temperature must be reached before disengaging turning gear, and which sensor verifies it?
cases.expected_answer: Minimum 38°C (100.4°F) verified via thermocouple TI-204.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Do not disengage turning gear until lube-oil feed manifold temp-erature reaches min. 38°C (100.4°F) [verified via thermocouple TI-204].

cases.question: Under the subscription agreement, what is the governing law for customers whose primary billing address is in the EEA?
cases.expected_answer: Under Exhibit B (EU Data Addendum), the agreement is governed by the laws of Ireland with exclusive venue in Dublin courts, modifying Section 11.2 (Delaware).
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 11.2 Governing Law]: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflicts of law principles. ... [Exhibit B EU Data Addendum Clause 6]: For Customers whose primary billing address is located within the European Economic Area, Section 11.2 is modified: this Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Dublin shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
cases.expected_source_location: Page 11, Exhibit B EU Data Addendum

cases.question: How quickly must Solis notify customers of a security incident, and what three details must the notice specify?
cases.expected_answer: Within 48 hours; notices must specify categories of data impacted, estimated count of affected individuals, and immediate corrective remediation actions.
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 6.2 Security Incidents]: Solis will notify Customer in writing within forty-eight (48) hours of confirming an unauthorized breach of Customer Data. ... [DPA Clause 4]: Breach notices shall specify the categories of data impacted, estimated count of affected individuals, and immediate corrective remediation actions.

cases.question: What service credit percentage is provided if monthly platform uptime falls below 95.0%?

| Less than 95.0% | 50% of monthly subscription fee |
